about: The source model of a Sentinel-2 Level-1C or Level-2A product in the SAFE format (spec/virtualize/safe.md, spec/virtualize.md §12 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/safe.md#12-safe-profile>), in its directory form (a store IR: one object per listed key) or its zip form (a file IR of the .SAFE.zip): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the product metadata, the tile geocoding, a band file's codestream, its tile-parts and a zip entry play, each with the constraints a product must meet to have the SAFE convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses, at the point the profile meets each role; projections read a valid IR and check nothing but the archive's own limits (reference payloads, output keys).

elements.about: The IR of a SAFE product. Names in angle brackets are variables. A band file's elements are the same in both forms: in the directory form under its object (described in place: its bytes are its own source's), in the zip form under `entries/<i>/data` of its zip entry.

children.boxes/<i>: struct: box i, in file order, up to the jp2c box
children.boxes/<i>/contents: bytes[n]: a box's contents (not the jp2c box's)
children.boxes/<i>/codestream/markers/<m>: struct: marker segment m of the main header after SIZ, with header {marker:>u2,length:>u2} and body bytes[L-2]
children.boxes/<i>/codestream/tiles/<k>: struct: tile-part k, with sot {marker:>u2,lsot:>u2,isot:>u2,psot:>u4,tpsot:u1,tnsot:u1} and body (data, form {"codec":"jpeg2000-tile-part","recipe":[["src",0,null]]})

<XML document>.kind: object (directory form, held when read) or value data (zip form)

zip form.entries/<i>: struct: the local header and data of central directory entry i, for each object that is not empty
zip form.entries/<i>/data: a band file (struct), an XML document (ascii[n] when stored, derived {"transform":"deflate"} when deflated), or another object (bytes[n])
zip form.central_directory/entries/<i>: struct: header {signature:<u4,version_made:<u2,version_needed:<u2,flags:<u2,method:<u2,time:<u2,date:<u2,crc32:<u4,compressed_size:<u4,size:<u4,name_length:<u2,extra_length:<u2,comment_length:<u2,disk:<u2,internal:<u2,external:<u4,local_header_offset:<u4}, name ascii[n], extra bytes[n], comment ascii[n]
zip form.gaps/<offset>: gap: bytes no element claims (local headers not read, an empty entry's)
